name: awedgerunner
description: Run agent and CI work on edge runners nobody has to rack -- a volunteer's idle GPU, a phone on your own mesh, an edge worker, a free or spot CI runner -- under a lease with a hard budget cap, a named payer and an expiry.
adopt: Open a lease with a one-dollar cap and a thirty-minute expiry, run one job under it, and watch the charge that would cross the cap be refused.
